messages:
nina: Starting a thread to design the Newsletter Launch + nurture automation for the Redwood Dispatch product launch. Objectives: convert trial users, surface high-value signals to SDRs, and run a subject-line + send-window test. Keep emails concise and product-centric. Thoughts on segmentation and immediate routing? :loudspeaker:

leo: Proposal: 5 segments not 4 — trial_new, trial_power_users, trial_idle, marketing_leads, customers. Each segment gets a tailored 3-email series over 14 days (welcome, use-case highlight, ROI story). Power users get a product-deep email earlier.

sarah: Add a "signal_strength" tiering: low/medium/high. High = dedicated deploy created OR api_calls_24h > 200 OR webhook:billing_estimate_requested. High -> immediate SDR alert (Slack + HubSpot task). Medium -> nurture + targeted product tips. Low -> long-tail drip + fortnightly newsletter.

leo: Here's a quick CSV snippet for segment rules we can import into Customer.io:
```
segment_key,description,criteria
trial_new,Signed up within 7 days,created_at >= now() - 7d
trial_power_users,Frequent usage,api_calls_24h >= 50
trial_idle,Low usage,last_14d_api_calls <= 2
marketing_leads,Inbound from ads or content,lead_source IN (blog,webinar,benchmark)
customers,Subscribed paying accounts,plan IN (pro,enterprise)
```

nina: Send timing suggestions (optimize by TZ):
- Americas: Mon/Tue 10:00 local
- EMEA: Tue/Wed 11:00 local
- APAC: Wed/Thu 09:30 local
- Reengage tests: Sunday 10:30 (small %)
We should cap sends to 25k/day until warmup complete. ops-bot, confirm send quota?

ops-bot: ESP send limit currently 40k/day. Recommend warmup cap 20k/day for 7 days to optimize deliverability. See deliverability report: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/dispatch-deliverability

jamal: Tracking plan: include utm_source=redwood_dispatch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dispatch_launch_q1 and event names: email_delivered, email_clicked, trial_activated, upgrade_purchased. Add header: X-RW-Email-Tag: launch_q1 for internal routing.

sarah: Subjects to test (A/B):
A) "Redwood Dispatch: cut inference cost, speed up responses"
B) "See how teams cut inference cost by 50% — Redwood Dispatch"
Run 50/50 on first send, pick winner after 36 hours and roll to remainder. Also test preheader copy for clarity.

leo: Routing -> HubSpot mapping idea (Customer.io webhook). If HubSpot 5xx, queue retry with exponential backoff and flag for ops. Example payload (stringified for Customer.io template):
```
{
  "email": "{{ customer.email }}",
  "lead_source": "dispatch_newsletter",
  "signal_strength": "{{ customer.vars.signal_strength }}",
  "api_calls_24h": "{{ customer.vars.api_calls_24h }}",
  "company_size": "{{ customer.company.size }}",
  "region": "{{ customer.company.region }}",
  "utm_campaign": "{{ campaign.name }}"
}
```

sarah: SDR routing: create a HubSpot view "Dispatch High Signals" and auto-create ASANA ticket or HubSpot task assigned by rotation. SLA: first contact within 45 minutes. Add enrichment: technographic + cloud provider if available.

nina: Suppression & compliance notes: never send to unsubscribed or complained addresses; suppress anyone with email_bounce_count > 3. For EU recipients include link to preference center and a 90-day GDPR reconsent workflow for lists > 6 months old.

leo: Deliverability checkpoints: seed list test to main ESPs, monitor opens/clicks for first 2 hours and pause if spam complaints > 0.02% in that window. ops-bot, add an alert to #marketing-inbox for complaint spikes.

ops-bot: Alert created: channel=#marketing-inbox, threshold=0.02%, window=2h.

jamal: Action items summarised:
- leo: finalize CSV of segments + importable field names (ETA tomorrow EOD)
- sarah: HubSpot webhook template + HubSpot property names + SDR view (ETA today 6pm)
- nina: subject lines + experiment plan + preference center copy (ETA today)
- ops-bot/ops: confirm send caps and set complaint alert (done)

nina: I'll create the live Google Sheet and link the customer.io flow mapping there. Anyone want edit access now? :busts_in_silhouette:

leo: Add me (leo@redwood.ai). Also tagging @jamal to review SDR SLA.

jamal: Reviewing. Thanks team — let's keep this thread for iterations and small decisions. I'll push the initial flow into Customer.io test workspace after the CSV is final. :thumbsup:
